sillyCard.desc: We <1>stole borrowed (with permission) all the character assets from Silly Wisher and gene spliced them into Genshin Optimizer.

tooltip.detectdup: Find upgrades/duplicates in the GO inventory and merge the import into GO.
tooltip.ignoreDup: Do not detect upgrades/duplicates. The import will be added on top of existing GO inventory.
tooltip.delWepArtiNotInImport: Assume the import is your full inventory of weapons and artifacts. Weapons and artifacts in the GO Inventory that don't exist in the import will be deleted.
tooltip.keepWepArtiNotInImport: Assume the import is a partial inventory of weapons and artifacts. Nothing will be deleted.
tooltip.delCharNotInImport: Assume the import is your full inventory of characters. Characters in the GO Inventory that don't exist in the import will be deleted.
tooltip.keepCharNotInImport: Assume the import is a partial inventory of characters. Nothing will be deleted.

cloudSync.title: Google Drive Cloud Synchronization
cloudSync.loginMsg: Sign in with your Google Drive account to enable automatic cloud backup and synchronization across devices. Your data is stored securely in your private, hidden Google Drive application folder.
cloudSync.disparityWarning: Warning: Data disparity detected between local and cloud backup.

conflictDialog.title: Cloud Synchronization Conflict
conflictDialog.desc: Divergent changes have been made locally and in your Google Drive cloud backup. Please select which version to keep.
conflictDialog.disparityAlert: Caution: One version has substantially less data than the other. Choosing the smaller version may cause irreversible loss of characters or artifacts.
